intent: The checks that drive the readiness meter. Readiness is computed from the state of the record, never self-reported. Each check declares which mode and scope combinations ask it, so the matrix lives here as data rather than as branching inside the skill or a screen.

model.meter_note: The percentage is for the person reading the screen. The gate is the blocking set, so 92 percent with one blocking check open is not ready, and the panel says which check.
model.not_asked: A check whose combination is not listed in asked_in reports n/a, stays visible, and is left out of the meter. It is not a failure and it is not owed later.

learn.label: Learn mode
learn.asks: the exploration set: A, C1, D2, D3, one B question, LQ and KC, plus triage

modes.note: One artifact in both modes: a Product Vision. A check a mode does not ask reports n/a, stays visible, and is left out of the meter. It is not a failure and it is not owed later.

checks.name: The change is stated
checks.test: C1 is present and substantive
checks.failure_message: There is no outcome statement, or it names a solution rather than a change.
checks.action: Write the change in the customer's world, with no product in it

checks.name: Lineage is linked
checks.test: scope new: an accepted opportunity, or an explicit note that none exists. scope increment: a parent vision resolves.
checks.failure_message: Nothing links this to an accepted opportunity or to a parent vision.

checks.name: Who drafted this is recorded
checks.test: core_team lists the people who drafted it, or records explicitly that someone was absent and why
checks.action: Record who formed this vision with you, or note who was missing
checks.failure_message: Nothing records who formed this vision. A vision drafted by the Product Lead alone is a proposal, not a team's direction.
checks.note: Context, not a gate. The Product Manager drafting alone is the normal case, not a defect.

checks.name: A primary measure has a sourced baseline
checks.test: at least one measure in C4 has baseline AND baseline_source
checks.failure_message: No measure carries both a baseline and its source, so there is nothing to judge this against later.

checks.name: Boundaries are stated
checks.test: D1 has at least one entry AND D2 has at least one entry
checks.failure_message: The adjacent list or the non-goals list is empty. These are what Step 7 and Step 9 build guardrails from.

checks.name: Human-in-the-loop posture is stated
checks.test: D3 is present
checks.failure_message: It does not say what a person always decides. The agent contract cannot be designed against it.
checks.action: Say what a person always decides, and what the agent does when it gets there

checks.name: Triage is settled
checks.test: every triage question is answered AND no answer is still not_sure
checks.failure_message: Triage has unresolved Not Sure answers. Each one engaged a reviewer conservatively and needs a Yes or a No.

checks.name: Every blocking reviewer has responded
checks.test: for each reviewer whose engagement is blocking at the computed tier, a response exists naming a responder and a date
checks.failure_message: The routed roster is incomplete. Named reviewers have not responded.
checks.action: Open the review round so the people who must respond can

checks.name: Every blocking raise is dispositioned
checks.test: no raise with severity blocking lacks a disposition of a documented type carrying that type's required fields
checks.failure_message: Blocking raises are still open.
checks.action: Disposition each open blocking raise: accepted with the change it produced, rejected with a reason, or deferred to a named step

checks.name: Rejected blocking constraints are acknowledged
checks.test: every blocking raise from a constrain reviewer with disposition rejected carries reviewer_acknowledged OR owner_override
checks.failure_message: A constraint was rejected without the reviewer's acknowledgement or the accountable owner's call.

checks.name: An accountable owner is named
checks.test: accountable_owner is a named person
checks.failure_message: No accountable owner is named, so there is nobody to ratify.

checks.name: Ratification is the accountable owner's act
checks.test: status is not ratified, OR ratified_by names the accountable owner
checks.failure_message: Marked ratified by somebody other than the named accountable owner, or by nobody. Ratification is a person's act, and it is that person's.

checks.name: The customer is named and their world described
checks.test: A1 names a role AND A5 describes a current state
checks.failure_message: The customer is a segment, or the current state is written as the absence of the solution.
checks.note: On an increment this is inherited from the parent vision and A10 carries what is new.

checks.name: The challenge or opportunity is stated
checks.test: A3 is present and states the problem in the customer's terms
checks.failure_message: No challenge or opportunity is stated, so nothing after it in block A has a referent.

checks.name: Customer priority is stated with a reason
checks.test: A4 carries a value from the scale AND a why
checks.failure_message: A3 needs both a priority value and the reason behind it. The value alone is not evidence.

checks.name: The committed outcome is named
checks.test: B00 names an outcome with what it would move, or explicitly records that none is served
checks.action: Name the committed outcome this serves, or record that none is
checks.failure_message: Nothing places this against an outcome the business is committed to, so it cannot be prioritised against the rest of the backlog.
checks.note: None is a passing answer. It means a new bet rather than a contribution, which is a different approval conversation.

checks.name: Business benefit categories are answered
checks.test: B0 has a value for every category, a ranking of the Yes set when more than one is Yes, and a why on the top three of that ranking
checks.failure_message: B0 is incomplete: a category is unanswered, the Yes set is unranked, or one of the top three has no reason behind it.
checks.note: A why on every Yes is busywork when seven are ticked. A why on the top three is the part a reviewer reads, and it is also what feeds the statement.
checks.action: Rank the benefits and give a reason for the top three

checks.name: Prior attempts are recorded, with their basis
checks.test: A7 carries a value, and when yes a how and a basis of known or inferred
checks.failure_message: A6 needs a value, and a Yes needs both what they did and whether that is known or inferred.
checks.note: A stated nothing passes. It is a real finding and it moves adoption to the dominant risk.

checks.name: What we are still figuring out is named
checks.test: LQd has at least one of What, How, For whom, For how much selected, and a primary when more than one
checks.action: Say which parts of this are still open
checks.failure_message: Nothing says which parts are still being figured out, so the learning question has no subject.

checks.name: Claims are marked known, inferred or gap
checks.test: A8 has a row per claim, every row carries a basis, and every known row carries a source
checks.failure_message: Claims are unmarked, or a known claim has no source behind it.
checks.action: Name a source for each claim marked known, or re-mark it inferred

checks.name: The prize is sized, or the gap is named
checks.test: B1 is present, and every figure in it carries a source or the absence of sizing is recorded as a gap with an owner
checks.failure_message: A figure appears with no source behind it. A number without a source is a gap, not a number.
checks.note: This is the most fabricated field in any vision, which is why it is the one with an explicit anti-fabrication test.

checks.name: Strategic fit and competitive position are stated
checks.test: B2 and B3 are both present
checks.failure_message: Why us, or what happens if we do not move, is unstated.

checks.name: Why now names what closes the window
checks.test: B4 is present and names a closing condition
checks.failure_message: The timing answer has no closing condition, which usually means the honest answer is not yet.

checks.name: The arc and what MVP proves are stated
checks.test: C2 has both parts
checks.failure_message: There is no arc, so no scope decision downstream can be judged as a step or a retreat.

checks.name: The statement exists and is well formed
checks.test: F1 has a stem and between three and five focus areas
checks.failure_message: There is no statement, or it has fewer than three or more than five focus areas.
checks.note: The statement becomes the scope test for every future increment, so a missing one costs more later than it does here.

checks.name: Who absorbs the change is named
checks.test: C3 names a role distinct from the beneficiary
checks.failure_message: It names who gains but not whose work changes.

checks.name: The pull-it condition is stated
checks.test: D4 has at least one entry
checks.failure_message: Nothing says what would make us turn it off, so Step 9 writes evaluation criteria without the product's intent behind them.

checks.name: The parent product is named
checks.test: parent_vision_ref names the product, and records one of: a linked vision, no vision document, or information unavailable with a reason
checks.failure_message: This improves a product that has not been named, or its lookup result was not recorded.
checks.note: All three outcomes pass. A product with no vision is normal, and information unavailable is a legitimate state worth counting. Silence about which product is not.

checks.name: The parent statement still covers this
checks.test: F2 is answered yes, OR the parent has no vision document
checks.failure_message: The parent statement does not cover this. Re-scope as a revision of the parent vision.
checks.note: Advisory rather than blocking, because it cannot run when the parent has no statement, which is the normal case for anything built before this skill. A No is still a routing result: re-scope.

checks.name: Why this increment, and why next
checks.test: B5 names the incremental value and what it was chosen over
checks.failure_message: Nothing says why this is the next most valuable thing to build on this product.

checks.name: Production signal is stated
checks.test: A11 is present
checks.failure_message: The live product has signal about this and none of it is recorded.

checks.name: The grant is recorded
checks.test: learn_mode.granted_by names the accountable owner AND granted_at AND grant_reason are present AND triage_at_grant records the triage as it stood at the grant
checks.failure_message: This is in Learn mode without a complete grant. Only the named accountable owner can grant it, in their name, with a reason, against a recorded triage.
checks.action: Record the grant with a reason, in the owner's name

checks.name: A review-by date is set
checks.test: learn_mode.review_by is a date
checks.failure_message: No review-by date. The owner granted Learn mode and needs a date on which they are asked about it again.

checks.name: The learning question is stated
checks.test: learn_mode.learning_question is present
checks.failure_message: It does not say what this build is going to answer.

checks.name: A kill condition is stated
checks.test: learn_mode.kill_condition is present
checks.failure_message: No result is named that would stop this. A proof of concept with no stopping condition is an unreviewed product.

checks.name: Non-goals are stated
checks.test: D2 has at least one item
checks.failure_message: Non-goals are asked in both modes. They cost one line and they become refusal behaviour later.

checks.name: Live promotion signals are acknowledged
checks.test: no live promotion signal lacks an entry in learn_mode.signal_acknowledgements, OR status is not ratified
checks.failure_message: A promotion signal is live and has not been acknowledged by the accountable owner.
checks.note: This check does not promote and does not decide anything. It guarantees that a Learn-mode vision cannot sit ratified while the owner has not seen a signal. Delete this rule if the organization wants signals purely informational.

checks.name: Evidence gaps have owners
checks.test: every gap of kind evidence carries an owner and a next action
checks.failure_message: Some evidence gaps have no owner, so nothing will close them.

checks.name: Advisory raises are answered
checks.test: no raise with severity advisory lacks a disposition
checks.failure_message: Advisory raises are unanswered. They do not hold the record, but reviewers notice.
checks.action: Answer the advisory raises, or record why each one stands

checks.name: Change rationale is present in revision mode
checks.test: pass_type is new OR every changed block carries a rationale
checks.failure_message: This is a revision pass and some changes have no rationale recorded.

checks.name: A revision names what it supersedes
checks.test: pass_type is not revision and scope is not revision, OR supersedes resolves
checks.failure_message: Marked as a revision with nothing recorded as superseded.
checks.note: A revision with no predecessor is read as a new vision by every check that branches on the combination, so the lineage is not merely missing - it changes which checks run.
checks.action: Link the vision this one supersedes

step_12.rule: A vision in Learn mode cannot be the basis of a GO at the Validation Decision. Clearing Step 12 requires Commit mode.
step_12.why: Step 12 produces a refined MVP scope recommendation, an output quality scorecard and safety and boundary results. Those read D1, D4 and C4 with sourced baselines, which are exactly the checks Learn mode does not ask. Step 12's REVISE path also re-enters at Step 7, which presumes something solid enough to design an agent contract against.
step_12.enforcement: The record carries its mode. The rule belongs to aipos-rapid-validation, which owns Step 12.
step_12.not_required_note: A Learn-mode vision that gets a no-go returns to the backlog as it is, with its learning. Most Learn-mode visions never reach Step 12 at all, which is the success case.

product_lead_confidence.prompt: How confident are you that this captures where the product should go?
product_lead_confidence.note: Recorded and shown to the accountable owner at ratification. It never gates. A Product Lead at 40 percent on something that meets every check is useful information, and it disappears if the only number on the screen is computed.

anti_gaming: No check is satisfied by the Product Lead asserting it
Reviewer responses are recorded against the named reviewer, not against the roster slot
Readiness recomputes on every change, so editing a block after reviewers responded reopens their checks for the blocks they raised against
Scope is a test, not a selection: S2 is what stops an increment being used to avoid a revision

coherence_warnings.name: Stated as critical, nothing done
coherence_warnings.test: A4 value is critical or high AND A7 value is no
coherence_warnings.says: Stated as %s, but nothing has been tried, built or paid for. Adoption, not capability, is the dominant risk here, and it should show in the measures and in the Step 11 plan.
coherence_warnings.note: A warning, never a failure. It is frequently the most useful line the verifier prints.
